extracted.intended_audience: Current Damon Runyon Fellows (postdoctoral fellows), host institutions' research/administrative offices, and prospective Damon Runyon-Dale F. Frey Award applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and program rules for applying to and administering the Damon Runyon-Dale F. Frey Award for Breakthrough Scientists, including selection criteria, eligibility, allowable uses of funds, reporting and terms of the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptional productivity and significant accomplishments during the Damon Runyon Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceptional productivity and significant accomplishments during the Damon Runyon Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellowship Award Committee will review applications and select awardees for approval by the Board of Directors. This is listed as a primary criterion for evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential to become a leader in cancer research
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential of the applicant to become a leader in the field of cancer research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators should assess the applicant's trajectory and indicators that they will emerge as a field leader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential impact of the research on cancer
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential of the research to impact the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of one or more forms of cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the likely translational or conceptual impact of the proposed/ongoing research on cancer-related outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer awareness of unconscious bias / commitment to DEI
rubrics_metrics.description: As an organization, the Foundation has an uncompromising commitment to excellence and values diversity, equity, and inclusion in all of its Award Programs. Reviewers should be aware of potential unconscious biases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement read at review start: promote gender equality and increase diversity; acknowledge that subtle/unconscious biases can affect outcomes and reviewers should be mindful when reviewing, scoring and discussing candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount, payment schedule, and expenditure timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: The award is $100,000 paid over one year and should be expended within two years of the initial award date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All awards will be made to the host institution for support of the designated investigator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowable uses of funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Funds are intended to be flexible and can be used for a variety of scientific needs including the awardee’s salary, salaries for professional and technical personnel, equipment, supplies, and other miscellaneous items required to conduct the research. Funds may also be used to defray the cost of the recipient’s healthcare benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides examples of permitted expenditures (investigator salary, technical staff, students and postdoctoral fellows, supplies, equipment, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on indirect costs / institutional overhead
rubrics_metrics.description: The award cannot be used for indirect costs or institutional overhead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions should not request or allocate any portion of the award to overhead/indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transferability of funds if awardee moves institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Should the awardee move to an independent position at another institution during the award period, the funds may be transferred to the new institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires coordination with the Foundation; funds are made to the host institution and may be transferred if the awardee moves to an independent position during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards made to host institution (no employer-employee relationship)
rubrics_metrics.description: All awards are made to the host institution for support of the designated Damon Runyon-Dale F. Frey Scientist. An award does not constitute an employer-employee relationship between the Foundation and the recipient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative/legal note clarifying institutional awardee and relationship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: timing (eligible in last year of Fellowship)
rubrics_metrics.description: Damon Runyon Fellows are eligible to apply in the last year of their Fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies the appropriate application window (and lists eligible cohorts selected in November 2022, May 2023, and February 2024 as examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: fellows who terminated early for independent faculty positions
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows who have terminated their awards early to accept an independent academic faculty position or other funding are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early termination to take an independent academic role does not disqualify the fellow from applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligibility: fellows who moved to for-profit organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows who have moved to a position at a for-profit organization are not eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Movement to for-profit employment disqualifies applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application frequency restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows may only apply once, at the deadline date that correlates with their award selection date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should confirm the correct deadline corresponding to their Fellowship selection date and apply only at that opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: technical summary of research
rubrics_metrics.description: At the completion of the award, the awardee must submit a summary of research performed during the award and evaluation of the results. The summary should be technical, but targeted to a general scientific audience. Figures and references may be included if appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports are kept confidential and serve as auditing tools to monitor research progress and award impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: lay abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: A lay abstract of total accomplishments over the term of the award, including impact of the research on cancer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepared for non-specialist audiences to summarize accomplishments and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: statement of award impact on the scientist
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement indicating how the Damon Runyon Dale F. Frey Award made a difference to the Scientist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe concrete ways the award affected research progress, career trajectory, or opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: collaborations and partnerships description
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief description of collaborations and partnerships related to the Damon Runyon-funded research, with either academic and/or industry scientists. Please identify your collaborator(s) and their academic/industrial affiliation(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List collaborators and affiliations; describe the nature and contributions of collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: statement of future plans
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement of future plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outline next steps, intended direction, and planned studies after the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: NIH Biosketch requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An up-to-date NIH Biosketch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide current NIH-format biosketch as part of final reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: intellectual property disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A completed intellectual property disclosure form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the Foundation's IP disclosure form to document inventions or disclosures arising from funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: community outreach / mentorship participation
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief description of your participation in any community-based educational mentorship initiatives or STEM outreach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe outreach/mentorship activities and scope of involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific final report: data sharing plan details
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you have any plans to share your data, either before or after its publication in a peer reviewed journal? If so: a. What type of data is it (genome/exome sequence, images, structures, statistical software or algorithms, etc.)? b. Where will it be shared (such as Figshare, Dataverse, Open Science Framework (OSF), Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) or Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB))? c. Who will be in charge of preparing the data to share? d. What are the expected costs of preparing and sharing this data?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete data-sharing plans addressing data type, repository, responsible person, and estimated costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial accountability: separate account and receipts
rubrics_metrics.description: The institution's financial officer must maintain a separate account including receipts for each award, and this account must be available for audit by representatives of the Foundation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain clear accounting records for the award; be prepared for Foundation audit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial expenditure timeframe and unexpended balance refund
rubrics_metrics.description: All funds should be expended within two years of the initial award date. Reports of expenditures must be submitted on the form provided by the Foundation and any unexpended balance refunded within 60 days of the award end or transfer date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to expenditure deadlines and use the Foundation's expenditure report form; refund remaining balances promptly when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial expenditure report form requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Please use the Foundation's form for the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation provides a specific form to report expenditures; institutions must use it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications and presentations acknowledgment
rubrics_metrics.description: Publications (including abstracts of presentations at scientific or clinical meetings) resulting from projects supported by the Foundation must carry the following acknowledgment: "[Name of Awardee] is supported (in part) by the Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation (DFS-#[___])."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the Foundation at awards@damonrunyon.org if you do not know your DFS#; awardees are encouraged to identify themselves as recipients when presenting and may download the Foundation logo for presentations/posters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to award statement and invention policy
rubrics_metrics.description: All awardees must adhere to the terms of both our award statement and our invention policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation will not modify the terms of its policies at the request of individual institutions; policies have been approved by the Board of Directors and are non-negotiable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission to receive additional awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Damon Runyon-Dale F. Frey Scientists are permitted to obtain additional awards or grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Receiving this award does not preclude holding other funding, but other terms (effort, reporting) still apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum effort commitment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Scientist must commit at least 80% of their full-time professional effort to research activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awardees are expected to devote a minimum of 80% effort to research supported by/related to the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to seek Foundation approval for institutional or award modifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Should the awardee wish to leave the designated institution or modify any aspect of the award, they must seek approval from the Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to comply with this requirement may jeopardize any future awards to the institution and/or awardee by the Foundation.
